title: WorkPulse leave.rejected v1
description: A pending leave request was rejected; the balance is untouched and the live wall is unaffected. Identifiers, type code, dates and actor only — the reason and decision note are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

start_date.description: First day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

end_date.description: Last day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

decided_by.description: Actor user id that rejected the request (ADR 0010 — never the requester).
